content.title: Mesa Wrongful Death Lawyer
content.text: If you have experienced the sudden, traumatic death of a loved one due to someone else’s negligence, speak to an experienced Mesa wrongful death lawyer for a chance to obtain justice for the losses you have endured. By filing a wrongful death claim against a negligent party, entity, or company with the legal team at Feller & Wendt, LLC™ you may be able to recover compensation to help with unforeseen expenses due to the loss of a loved one and emotional suffering that occurs after a wrongful death accident.After suffering a devastating loss because of someone else’s careless actions, it is understandable that the grieving family takes legal action to help with the mounting expenses and psychological distress that comes with losing a loved one. Wrongful death claims are personal injury cases filed on the behalf of the deceased, but there may be a few differences in how to proceed. Speak with a Mesa wrongful death lawyer for an assessment of your case and skilled guidance on your next steps. Schedule a free legal consultation via our contact form or call 480.702.2277 for a consultation with our legal team. What Rights May Family Members Have After a Wrongful Death of a Loved One in Mesa? Family members have the right to pursue wrongful death damages on the behalf of a loved one in Mesa. In Arizona, this may include a spouse, parent, or children. As explained in statute 12-611, wrongful death is described as an act, neglect, or default of another person that resulted in a loss of life and allows the family to recover damages from the party responsible.Personal injuries that directly affect a victim would typically be initiated by the affected party, but since the victim cannot initiate one on their own behalf, the family can pursue accountability in such accidents:Medical malpracticeA negligence-based accidentA violent crime or other intentional accidentWith the help of an experienced Mesa lawyer, you may be able to pursue damages on the behalf of your loved one in order to obtain justice for their wrongful death. Speak with a compassionate Mesa wrongful death lawyer for an assessment of your claim. What Wrongful Death Damages Can Be Obtained in Mesa? Closure is important in wrongful death cases. That is why it is important to speak with an experienced Mesa wrongful death lawyer to obtain justice and compensation for past, future, and current expenses you are facing. Damages in a wrongful death case may include:Medical expenses in regard to an accident or medical malpracticeLoss of incomeFuneral expensesLoss of companionshipPain and sufferingEmotional distressPunitive damages Wrongful death cases can be extremely personal and unique, depending on the circumstances. It is best to work with an experienced Mesa wrongful death lawyer for a chance to obtain the most favorable outcome for you and your loved one. Damages may be awarded based on the victim’s death, income, future earnings, and non-economic losses experienced by the grieving family. Punitive damages may be awarded in unique circumstances for wrongful death cases and are not limited by the monetary value of losses that the affected family has suffered. Punitive damages are set up to punish the negligent party for the substantial harm that they have caused and to deter them from repeating those actions in the future. For instance, the statute of limitations in Arizona is two years after the loss of your loved one in order to be eligible for compensation.While the statute of limitations may be strict, there are special circumstances in specific cases. A knowledgeable Mesa wrongful death lawyer can evaluate your case and determine whether you can still move forward with your claim. If your lawyer deems that you may pursue a wrongful death claim, the following are general steps to take when filing a claim:It is essential that you have your claim evaluated by a seasoned wrongful death lawyer. Your lawyer can begin an extensive investigation into your claim.When your Mesa wrongful death lawyer begins an in-depth investigation, they will gather, evaluate, and document valuable evidence pertinent to your case.Your attorney will evaluate important liability policies and determine the amount of compensation you are owed.Once the proper evidence and documentation have been obtained, your wrongful death lawyer will contact the negligent party to inform them of your intent to pursue damages.We will negotiate a settlement at that time to obtain a favorable outcome. If we cannot agree to a settlement, we may move forward with a lawsuit.Proving negligence and liability in a wrongful death claim is similar to proving negligence in a personal injury case. If the negligent party owed your deceased loved one an adequate duty of care and failed to uphold that through negligent actions, you have a right to file a claim on their behalf.
